fields.description: Marèva 2 is a four- to six-bedroom villa release within The Oasis. Its setting centres on lagoons, landscaped open spaces and outdoor recreation, with contemporary homes arranged as part of the wider waterfront community. This second release has its own villa mix and launch schedule.

overview: The shared collection brochure describes neutral interiors, contrasting textures and homes oriented towards outdoor living. Its community programme combines water-based leisure with parks, sports and wellness facilities. These are masterplan features; their exact delivery and access arrangements need to be checked for the selected plot.

Marèva 2’s own fact sheet is the basis for this page’s minimum built-up and plot areas. A minimum land area and a minimum built-up area need not describe the same villa. Compare the individual plot schedule and plan before judging garden space, privacy or frontage.
research.locationNote: Marèva 2 sits within The Oasis in Dubai. Its setting includes waterways and landscaped spaces, but views, direct lagoon access and distances to facilities depend on the particular plot.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 13.83m. The Marèva 2 launch sheet lists four-bedroom villas from AED 13.83m, five-bedroom villas from AED 15.85m and six-bedroom villas from AED 27.05m. These references do not confirm current stock or a unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The release schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% at completion. Later payments depend on construction milestones. Historical instalment dates are retained as launch information; current balances and revised terms require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The phase-two payment sheet estimates February 2030. Property Finder reports the same month. Treat this as a published target subject to the sale agreement and current developer updates.

facts.label: Phase-two launch mix
facts.value: 346 standalone villas: 177 four-bedroom, 119 five-bedroom and 50 six-bedroom homes. This is the launched collection rather than available inventory.

facts.label: Availability distinction
facts.value: Property Finder labels the release sold out while Emaar retains a starting price and interest form. A published price is therefore not a confirmation of direct availability.

unresolved: Confirm current direct or resale availability, plot-specific price, service charges and outstanding payment balance.

The developer serves the same brochure and plan files for Marèva and Marèva 2. Exact elevation, basement/roof arrangement, pool provision and plot allocation must match the selected phase-two unit’s signed documents.
Published BUA and plot values are category minimums, not an individual villa’s measurements. Final dimensions and specifications may differ.
Community amenity delivery, access conditions and any separately charged services require confirmation.
February 2030 is an estimated construction-completion date, not a guarantee of occupation or final handover.
